description: Use when a seller advertises an ERC-8004 identity and you need an ERC-8478 Draft wallet-binding observation. ERC-8478 Draft payee verification: endpoint origin and ERC-8004 agent wallet or EIP-712 delegation at one pinned registry block. Nine explicit outcomes; not-read is uncharged. Signed JSON observation, not payment approval or a safety guarantee. Shared trial may apply. Price: 0.01 USDC. Minimal input example: {"requirement":{"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:8453","asset":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","amount":"10000","payTo":"0xBf4164e07552e4c1b1B1597E72C7acAA3F0a1c58"},"resource_url":"https://api.spendpreflight.com/v1/check"}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"result":{"kind":"payee_binding","outcome":"no-identity","block_number":null,"block_timestamp":null},"jws":"illustrative-not-a-live-signature"}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): First use the existing shared allowance of 3 eligible calls per IP per UTC day, without payment metadata. This is shared with eligible HTTP trials, not a new allowance. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.

agentId.description: Optional. Unsigned ERC-8004 agent ID as a decimal integer string, not a JS number. Example: "1151628". Supply together with registry; may instead use advertised extra.erc8004.

registry.description: Optional. ERC-8004 registry string in eip155:chainId:0xAddress format. Example: eip155:8453:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432. Supply together with agentId; may instead use advertised extra.erc8004.

requirement.description: Required. One exact-scheme x402 payment requirement JSON object. Example: {"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:8453","asset":"0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913","payTo":"0xBf4164e07552e4c1b1B1597E72C7acAA3F0a1c58","amount":"10000"}. Supply resource here or resource_url separately; amounts are atomic integer strings.

amount.description: Optional. Quoted amount as a nonnegative atomic-unit integer string, not decimal USDC. Example: "10000" = 0.01 USDC at six decimals. Required when maxAmountRequired is absent.

asset.description: Required. Quoted token asset identifier string; EVM assets use a 0x-prefixed 20-byte contract address. Example: 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913 (native Base USDC).

extra.description: Optional. Advertised x402 extension JSON object, preserved as supplied. Example: {"erc8004":{"registry":"eip155:8453:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432","agentId":"1151628"}}. Identity fields must match explicit registry/agentId if both are supplied.

maxAmountRequired.description: Optional. x402 v1 amount as a nonnegative atomic-unit integer string. Example: "10000" = 0.01 USDC. Required when amount is absent.

network.description: Required. Payment network identifier string; use the quoted CAIP-2 identifier. Example: eip155:8453.

payTo.description: Required. Quoted recipient identifier string; EVM recipients use a 0x-prefixed 20-byte address. Example: 0xBf4164e07552e4c1b1B1597E72C7acAA3F0a1c58.

resource.description: Optional. Absolute HTTP(S) resource URL string. Example: https://api.example.com/data. Required here or in resource_url.

scheme.description: Required. Payment scheme literal string exact. Example: exact; other schemes are unsupported.

resource_url.description: Optional. Absolute HTTP(S) resource URL string. Example: https://api.example.com/data. Supply if the resource URL is absent from the challenge or requirement.
